findings.text: internal/console/static/chat.js: The Do it handler sends an empty body when the edited amount is blank or non-finite. That confirms the captured suggestion rather than rejecting the edit. Clearing a EUR 10 proposal previews EUR 0.00 but clicking Do it can still apply EUR 10. Only omit the correction for a valid, unchanged amount; invalid edits must not silently approve the original amount. Add harness coverage for clearing the input and malformed number input.

internal/console/static/chat.js (poolFormHTML): The proposal amount is inside a standalone form whose submit event is not intercepted. With its single numeric field, pressing Enter on a valid edited amount performs a native GET submission to the current page, reloading the panel instead of preserving the edit for Do it. Prevent native submission or use a non-form container.

internal/console/static/chat.js (poolHost submit listener): The busy check returns before e.preventDefault(). Submitting the pool control during an active chat turn therefore falls through to the form's default GET submission, navigating away and placing the amount and reason in the URL. Cancel the native submission before checking busy, and disable or safely ignore the control while a turn is running.
